card.title: Vice President of Quality Assurance
card.description:
**Vice President of Quality Assurance (VP of Quality Assurance)**

**Location:**
Remote – United States

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Vice President of Quality Assurance to lead the company's quality assurance organization and establish a strong framework for operational excellence. This executive will oversee quality standards, develop testing and evaluation strategies, strengthen compliance practices, and ensure that products, services, and business processes consistently meet organizational and customer expectations. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven ability to drive continuous improvement across multiple departments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute the company's overall quality assurance strategy in alignment with business objectives and operational priorities.
* Establish quality standards, policies, procedures, and performance benchmarks across relevant business functions.
* Lead quality assurance teams and oversee testing, inspection, auditing, and evaluation activities.
* Monitor quality performance indicators, identify recurring issues, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Collaborate with product development, engineering, operations, and customer service teams to improve quality throughout the organization.
* Oversee the development and implementation of quality management systems and standardized operating procedures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal quality policies.
* Evaluate operational processes and recommend improvements that reduce defects, minimize risks, and increase efficiency.
* Direct internal quality audits and coordinate external assessments when necessary.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop quality assurance leaders and professionals while building a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Present quality performance reports, audit findings, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Manage departmental budgets, staffing plans, and resources to support quality objectives.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
* Extensive experience in quality assurance, quality management, compliance, or operational excellence, including senior leadership responsibilities.
* Demonstrated success developing quality strategies and implementing effective quality management systems.
* Strong understanding of quality control methodologies, auditing practices, risk management, and continuous improvement principles.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence quality standards across an organization.
* Experience establishing performance metrics, analyzing quality data, and driving corrective action initiatives.
* Familiarity with relevant industry regulations, quality frameworks, and process improvement methodologies.

**Why Join Us**

This is an opportunity to shape the company's quality vision and establish standards that support long-term operational success. As Vice President of Quality Assurance, you will work closely with executive leadership, guide quality initiatives across the organization, develop talented teams, and help ensure consistent performance, reliability, and customer confidence.

card.title: Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance
card.description:
**Business Unit:**
Miltope Corporation

**Location:**
Hope Hull, AL

This position is an exempt salaried role that normally works a 9/80 work schedule. Non-duty hours work may be required based on business needs.

**Who YOU are and what YOU can become:**

You are a high-performing strategist with a commitment to excellence, attention to detail, and a knack for identifying areas of improvement. You are looking for a role that serves a noble purpose: supporting our nation's warfighters.

**Who WE are and where WE are going:**

At ST Engineering North America Government, Miltope Corporation, we apply technology and innovation to solve real-world problems and improve lives. Our dedication to excellence has earned us a reputation for quality and trust as a global technology, defense, and engineering group. Our diverse portfolio spans aerospace, smart city, defense, and public security.

**What YOU will do:**

Miltope Corporation is seeking an experienced aerospace quality and regulatory compliance executive to lead the company's Quality organization and ensure continued compliance with applicable Department of War, Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), and customer requirements.

This position is responsible for the development, implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of quality management systems supporting, but not limited to:

* FAA Part 21 Production Approval operations.
* FAA Part 145 Certified Repair Station operations.
* EASA Part 145 Approved Maintenance Organization operations.

The Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance will serve as the senior independent authority for quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and quality system effectiveness across production and repair station operations.

Reporting directly to the CEO/President, this individual will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Repair Station management to ensure regulatory requirements are implemented, monitored, and maintained.

The successful candidate must establish an effective quality culture while possessing the technical knowledge and operational experience necessary to engage directly in regulatory matters, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory Compliance and Quality System Leadership**

* Maintain responsibility for quality management system effectiveness and compliance supporting FAA Part 21 and FAA/EASA Part 145 operations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA regulations, including 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, and EASA Part-145 requirements.
* Maintain and oversee Quality Manuals, Repair Station Manuals, Quality Control Manuals, and associated procedures.
* Ensure regulatory requirements, approved procedures, and customer-specific quality requirements are communicated and implemented.
* Monitor regulatory changes and evaluate their impact on operations, procedures, and approvals.
* Serve as the primary Quality representative in regulatory compliance matters and coordinate with designated Accountable Managers and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure organizational responsibilities, delegated authorities, and quality reporting relationships are clearly defined.

**FAA and EASA Regulatory Oversight**

* Oversee FAA Production Approval compliance, including organizational controls, production conformity, quality assurance, and product traceability.
* Oversee FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality control activities, ensuring compliance with applicable manuals and Operations Specifications.
* Ensure EASA Part-145 compliance monitoring requirements are implemented and maintained.
* Ensure the designated EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager has the independence, authority, resources, and organizational access necessary to perform assigned responsibilities.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections, audits, surveillance activities, and responses to FAA and EASA findings.
* Maintain effective relationships with FAA, EASA, and other regulatory authorities.
* Ensure timely notification, investigation, and resolution of reportable quality and regulatory issues.

**Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain an effective internal audit program covering production, repair station operations, suppliers, and supporting business functions.
* Ensure timely identification, documentation, investigation, and resolution of nonconformances and audit findings.
* Maintain an effective corrective and preventive action (CAPA) process, including root cause analysis and verification of effectiveness.
* Monitor quality performance metrics, identify adverse trends, and drive improvement initiatives.
* Ensure controls for material acceptance, inspection, product conformity, nonconforming material, configuration management, calibration, and quality records.
* Oversee supplier quality management, including qualification, monitoring, and corrective actions.
* Drive a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and regulatory compliance.

**Organizational Leadership and Executive Accountability**

* Report directly to the CEO/President on regulatory compliance, quality performance, significant risks, and corrective actions.
* Maintain independence from Manufacturing, Operations, and Repair Station production functions when performing quality oversight and compliance monitoring.
* Escalate significant quality and regulatory compliance concerns directly to executive leadership.
* Establish appropriate quality-related authority, including initiating product or maintenance holds and preventing release or return to service when requirements have not been satisfied, consistent with approved procedures and delegated authority.
* Partner with functional leaders to implement and sustain corrective actions.
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Quality organization to ensure technical competency, staffing, and succession planning.
* Provide executive management with objective assessments of quality system effectiveness and regulatory compliance.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Aviation, or a related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant aerospace industry experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in defense or aerospace quality assurance, regulatory compliance, manufacturing quality, or aviation maintenance quality.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing a quality organization or regulatory compliance function.
* Demonstrated experience within an FAA-regulated aerospace manufacturing organization holding a Part 21 Production Approval.
* Direct experience with FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality systems and regulatory requirements.
* Working knowledge of EASA Part-145 requirements, including compliance monitoring and organizational independence.
* Experience managing regulatory audits, responding to findings, and coordinating corrective actions with FAA, EASA, and customer representatives.
* Strong knowledge of aerospace quality management systems, including AS9100, AS9110, or equivalent standards.
* Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA systems, supplier quality, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical procedures and controls.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, regulatory authorities, customers, and employees at all levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience overseeing multiple regulatory approvals or certifications within a single organization.
* Experience with aerospace manufacturing and component repair/maintenance operations.
* Experience serving as or directly supporting a Part 21 Accountable Manager, FAA Part 145 Accountable Manager, or EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager.
* Experience with AS9100/AS9110 certification audits and aerospace customer audits.
* Experience implementing and maintaining risk-based quality systems and safety management processes.
* Experience managing quality organizations across multiple facilities or operating locations.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Independence, integrity, and willingness to address difficult quality and regulatory issues.
* Ability to influence executive leadership and operational management.
* Strong technical judgment and understanding of aviation product safety and airworthiness.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks and preventing compliance issues.
* Ability to balance regulatory requirements with practical business and operational considerations.
* Hands-on leadership style and willingness to engage in the details.

**Measures of Success**

* Sustained compliance with FAA Part 21 and FAA/EASA Part 145 requirements.
* Successful completion of regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.
* Timely and effective resolution of audit findings and corrective actions.
* Effective quality system performance and reduction of recurring nonconformances.
* Strong organizational understanding of quality responsibilities and regulatory requirements.
* An independent, empowered Quality organization that supports business performance while protecting product conformity, airworthiness, and regulatory compliance.

**Please contact:**
Human Resources at hr@miltope.com

It takes diverse talent to solve real-world problems. ST Engineering/Miltope Corporation is deeply committed to building a workplace community where inclusion is valued and everyone feels welcomed. We are proud to consider all qualified applicants for employment. Miltope is an equal opportunity employer.

Miltope Corporation is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in the employment application process. To request an accommodation, please contact Human Resources.

card.title: VP, Quality
card.description:
***Archer**
is collaborating with
**Stord**
to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.*
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
 
 
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
 
 
With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
 
 
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
 
 
**About The Role**
Stord is looking for a Vice President of Quality to build and lead the quality function across our fulfillment network.
 
 
This leader will own the systems, standards, and operating mechanisms that ensure inventory is accurate, processes are followed, and every order moves through our network the way it was designed to. The mandate spans the full lifecycle of inventory inside our buildings from inbound receipt and putaway through picking, packing, sorting, and outbound shipment.
 
 
This is an independent quality function. While our Operations teams are responsible for delivering volume efficiently, the VP of Quality is responsible for ensuring we never achieve speed, growth, or cost improvements by compromising inventory integrity or execution quality.
 
 
This leader should be an inventory and fulfillment quality expert at heart — someone who understands how inventory moves through a complex fulfillment operation, knows where process breakdowns create downstream failures, and is relentless about identifying and eliminating root causes.
 
 
**What You'll Own**
**Inventory Health & Accuracy**

* Own inventory health and accuracy across Stord's fulfillment network.
* Establish the standards, controls, and operating mechanisms required to maintain book-to-floor and floor-to-book inventory integrity.
* Own cycle counting, inventory reconciliation, adjustment governance, and inventory variance reduction.
* Build mechanisms to identify inventory defects early and systematically eliminate their root causes.
* Establish network-level metrics and reporting that make inventory health visible and actionable.

**Fulfillment Process Quality**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Senior Manager, Global Development Quality Assurance to join our Global Development Quality Assurance (GDQA) team, supporting our Global Development (GD) organization. In this role, you will lead quality auditing programs, and compliance oversight across GLP activities while collaborating with GD, cross-functional stakeholders, and quality partners. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
 
 
**When & Where**
Location: Tarrytown, NY
 
 
Work model: On-Site
 
 
**Discover Your Role**

* Responsible for performing QAU functions: Study Audits and Facility/Process audits.
* Audit responsibilities may include external audits conducted globally.
* This role may require 20 – 30% travel (both domestic and international).
* Represent the GDQA department by providing audit and compliance input in cross functional meetings
* Lead the identification of internal quality/compliance issues and act as a catalyst for process improvements to promote standardization and best practices both within GDQA and across Regeneron.
* Represents GDQA on high-priority teams, compliance projects and initiatives both within and across functional areas or other departments as applicable.
* Interpret and may assist in developing policies and standards, and evaluate potentially critical problems not covered by policies, standards, and regulations.
* Provides education and/or training to GDQA and other relevant Global Development departments.
* May participate in regulatory inspections by acting as part of the control and/or inspection room team

**This Role Requires**

* Bachelor’s degree (Master’s degree preferred) with 8+ years of relevant industry experience
* 5+ years in Quality Assurance or a related regulated quality laboratory role supporting bioanalytical, pharmacokinetics and pathology portions of studies
* Prior exposure to Quality in GLP environments required; experience performing QAU functions; GCP exposure a plus
* Expertise with 21 CFR Part 58 (FDA GLP) and OECD Principles of GLP required
* Exposure to ICH E6 (GCP) and CLIA regulations are a plus but not required
* Experience with FDA or other Regulatory Agency Inspections, Sponsors or CROs.
* Systems experience working in LIMS, ELN, Veeva QMS is highly preferred
* Demonstrated skills in taking initiative and working independently in a dynamic environment to effectively manage multiple complex priorities
* Strong leadership with demonstrated ability to interface with both peers and senior leaders
* Critical thinking and problem solving, written and verbal communication skills
* Strong track record of project management, stakeholder management, collaboration skills and negotiation of complex situations
* Attention to detail and accuracy of work

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.
 
 
Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.
 
 
Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.
 
 
As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.
 
 
For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

SVP, ENVIRONMENT, SAFETY, HEALTH & QUALITY (ESHQ)
 
 
Hanwha Qcells USA Corp (Qcells USA), headquartered in Houston, TX, specializes in providing utility-scale modules, solar photovoltaic (PV), and battery energy storage systems (BESS) project development, along with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services for solar and BESS projects nationwide. Qcells USA delivers comprehensive turnkey solutions encompassing the entire utility-scale project lifecycle. By choosing Qcells USA for turnkey solutions, customers can reduce uncertainty and risk, leading to enhanced investment returns and contributing to a more sustainable future.
 
 
Qcells USA’s complete turnkey solutions seamlessly integrate the expertise of our Development, Module, and EPC teams, while ensuring close coordination with other vital internal groups such as Project Finance, Systems Integration, and Legal. This collaborative approach ensures that Qcells USA projects deliver exceptional value and performance. With several multi-billion-dollar investments, Qcells is pioneering the establishment of the only complete module supply chain in the U.S., including the expansion of our Georgia module manufacturing facility, which stands as the largest in the Western Hemisphere.
 
 
As an integral part of the global Qcells brand, Qcells USA benefits from a legacy of excellence in photovoltaic manufacturing. Qcells is renowned worldwide for its high-performance, superior-quality solar cells and modules. With dual headquarters in Seoul, South Korea (Global Executive HQ) and Thalheim, Germany (Technology & Innovation HQ), Qcells operates under the umbrella of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 company and one of the top 8 business conglomerates in South Korea.
 
 
**Summary**
The SVP, Environment, Safety, Health & Quality (ESHQ) provides senior executive leadership over all environmental, safety, health, and quality programs across Qcells USA's EPC construction operations. This role is accountable for developing and executing the company's integrated ESHQ strategy, driving a zero-incident safety culture, embedding construction quality excellence into every phase of project delivery, ensuring regulatory compliance, and managing ESHQ performance across active utility-scale solar PV and BESS project sites nationwide.
 
 
Working in close partnership with EPC project leadership, site teams, subcontractors, and corporate stakeholders, the SVP, ESHQ sets the enterprise standard for environmental stewardship, occupational health, construction safety, and quality management. This role serves as the primary ESHQ authority for the EPC business, owns the company's Quality Management System (QMS), and represents Qcells USA with regulatory agencies, clients, certification bodies, and industry organizations. This position reports to the COO, or another management personnel that the CEO of the Company may designate. This position is hybrid, based out of our Houston, TX office, requiring up to 4 days per week in the office. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00am to 5:00pm or 9:00am to 6:00pm local time. This position is expected to travel up to 40%.
 
 
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.
 
 
**Essential Job Function & Responsibilities**

* Define and lead the integrated ESHQ strategy for Qcells USA's EPC business, aligning programs with corporate goals, project requirements, client expectations, and regulatory standards across the ESH and Quality functions
* Build, develop, and manage a high-performing ESHQ organization including site safety managers, environmental coordinators, industrial hygienists, quality managers, and QA/QC engineers across multiple active projects
* Establish and enforce ESHQ policies, standards, and integrated management systems including ISO 45001 (Safety), ISO 14001 (Environmental), ISO 9001 (Quality), OSHA, and EPA requirements applicable to utility-scale solar and BESS construction
* Drive a proactive zero-incident safety culture through leadership engagement, hazard recognition programs, behavioral safety initiatives, and accountability frameworks embedded across all project sites and subcontractor workforces
* Oversee incident investigation processes; ensure root cause analyses are thorough, corrective actions are implemented, and lessons learned are shared across the project portfolio and incorporated into future planning
* Lead emergency preparedness and crisis response planning for site-level incidents; serve as executive escalation point for serious incidents, regulatory actions, or significant near-misses
* Monitor and ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local environmental, safety, and health regulations across all project sites and corporate operations
* Manage environmental permitting, compliance monitoring, stormwater and spill prevention plans, and environmental impact mitigation programs for EPC projects from NTP through construction completion
* Manage relationships with OSHA, EPA, and state regulatory agencies; lead responses to inspections, citations, and enforcement actions with urgency and thoroughness
* Own and continuously improve Qcells USA's Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring it is documented, implemented, audited, and certified in accordance with ISO 9001 and applicable client and contractual quality requirements
* Oversee the development, issuance, and field implementation of Construction Quality Management Plans (CQMPs), Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and quality specifications for all EPC projects
* Manage the non-conformance report (NCR) process across the portfolio, ensuring timely identification, documentation, disposition, and systemic corrective action to prevent recurrence
* Lead quality audits of Qcells USA's construction operations and subcontractor quality programs; drive corrective action plans and track closure to ensure sustained compliance
* Partner with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction teams to integrate quality requirements at the design, procurement, and field execution stages, minimizing rework and defect costs
* Oversee construction punchlist management and systems turnover quality processes, ensuring projects are handed over to owners with complete documentation and no outstanding quality deficiencies
* Develop and maintain ESHQ metrics, KPIs, and reporting frameworks across both safety and quality dimensions; present integrated performance data and strategic updates to executive leadership and the Board
* Partner with EPC project managers and construction managers to integrate ESHQ requirements into project planning, scheduling, and execution from bid phase through close-out
* Oversee ESHQ orientation, training programs, and competency assessments for craft workers, site supervisors, and subcontractor personnel covering safety, environmental, and quality topics
* Support client ESHQ audits, pre-qualification requirements, and quality reporting obligations across the EPC project portfolio
* Develop and manage the ESHQ department budget, including staffing, equipment, training, certifications, and third-party services
* Represent Qcells USA in industry associations, safety councils, quality forums, and regulatory proceedings to advance ESHQ best practices in the renewable energy construction sector
* Regular attendance, in accordance with company's attendance policy and supervisory assignment, is an essential job duty requirement for this position
* Perform other duties and special projects, as assigned by Management

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Science, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
* Minimum of 18 years of progressive ESHQ leadership experience, with at least 7 years in a senior or executive role with accountability across both ESH and Quality functions
* Demonstrated experience leading integrated ESHQ programs in large-scale construction, EPC, energy, or infrastructure environments; utility-scale solar or BESS construction experience strongly preferred
* Deep knowledge of OSHA construction standards (29 CFR 1926), EPA regulations, NFPA 70E, and applicable state safety and environmental requirements
* Proven expertise in Quality Management Systems including ISO 9001 implementation, internal auditing, NCR management, and construction QA/QC program leadership on utility-scale EPC projects
* Experience with integrated management system frameworks (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001) and leading third-party certification or surveillance audits
* Proven ability to build and lead geographically dispersed ESHQ teams across multiple concurrent project sites
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Quality Manager (CQM), or equivalent professional certification required or strongly preferred; CIH a plus
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence project leadership, subcontractors, clients, and field personnel at all levels of the organization
* Experience managing regulatory relationships and leading responses to OSHA inspections, EPA audits, client quality audits, or state agency enforcement actions
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to present complex ESHQ performance data and strategy to executive leadership, clients, and certification bodies
* Strong organizational and program management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across a fast-paced, growing construction portfolio

EXAMPLES OF PHYSICAL DEMANDS
 
 

* Stationary Position: frequently remains stationary up to 90% of the time and sitting up to 8 hours in a day
* Move/Traverse: infrequently bend, stand, stoop and/or walk
* Carry Weight: infrequently carry weight and/or lift objects (light to heavy) weighing up to 10 pounds
* Hearing and Speech: frequently communicates with the ability to hear and talk on a regular basis with employees, coworkers, and all personnel matters; must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations
* Sight: frequent use of sight to detect images on computer, office documents, and office objects near and far
* Climb: occasionally ascends/descends on stairway to get to office upper and lower floors
* Travel: up to 40% as needed

EXAMPLES OF WORK ENVIRONMENT
 
 

* Regular professional, office business setting
* Noise level ranges from low to moderate (if in office setting)
* Noise level ranges from moderate to high (if on construction worksite)
* Under the Office Mobilization Plan (OMP) policy, the role may transition to an onsite or hybrid arrangement, as determined by business needs and the Head of Department

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
 
 
It is important to note that the job descriptions provided by Qcells USA Corp are not intended to be comprehensive lists of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the positions. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice, reflecting our dynamic and evolving work environment.
 
 
We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Hanwha Qcells will provide reasonable accommodations to all qualified individuals with disabilities to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations at hr-usa@qcells.com.

**About LeonaBio:**
LeonaBio, Inc., headquartered in the Seattle, Washington area, is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapeutics for high unmet medical needs, including treatment-resistant metastatic breast cancer and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Our lead programs, lasofoxifene and brelgometon, are novel small-molecule therapies with the potential to address devastating diseases where current treatment options are limited or ineffective. We are committed to scientific excellence and patient-centered innovation as we advance meaningful new therapies for patients.
 
 
**Position Summary**
LeonaBio is seeking an experienced, hands-on Vice President, Quality to lead the company's Quality function through the transition from late-stage clinical development to regulatory approval, commercial launch, and lifecycle management. This executive will be responsible for designing, implementing, and scaling a phase-appropriate Quality Management System and Quality Risk Management framework that meets global regulatory requirements, reflects the company's size and stage, and supports commercial operations.
 
 
The ideal candidate has direct leadership experience in a biotechnology company developing and commercializing small-molecule products, with a demonstrated track record of building or materially transforming Quality systems and governance. This individual will integrate product quality, patient, compliance, supply, vendor, inspection, and commercialization risks into enterprise decision-making and provide clear, risk-based guidance to executive leadership and the Board. The Vice President, Quality will foster a practical culture of quality that supports timely business decisions, inspection readiness, reliable product supply, and sustainable commercial operations.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the executive leader for LeonaBio's Quality function, providing strategic direction across quality systems, clinical development, manufacturing, and regulatory compliance.
* Develop and execute a scalable, phase-appropriate Quality strategy that supports late-stage clinical development, regulatory submissions, commercial readiness, and lifecycle management.
* Own the architecture, implementation, effectiveness, and scaling of the company's pharmaceutical Quality Management System (QMS) and Quality Risk Management (QRM) framework, ensuring inspection readiness and alignment with a lean, outsourced operating model.
* Ensure compliance with applicable global GxP requirements, including GMP, GCP, and GVP, while maintaining a pragmatic, risk-based approach to Quality. Lead inspection readiness, audits, quality governance, and timely resolution of observations.
* Establish and oversee the Quality governance model for CMOs, CDMOs, CROs, contract laboratories, suppliers, and other GxP partners, including qualification, quality agreements, audits, performance monitoring, risk escalation, change control, investigations, validation, and supply continuity.
* Provide Quality leadership across small-molecule drug substance and drug product development, technology transfer, process validation and PPQ, analytical methods, stability, specifications, packaging, commercial launch, and post-approval lifecycle management.
* Build and develop a high-performing Quality organization, including leadership of the Senior Director of Quality Assurance, while fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline required; advanced degree (MS, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent) preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive Quality experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical companies, including significant leadership responsibility in lean, resource-constrained environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading Quality strategy through late-stage clinical development, regulatory submissions, and commercial readiness, including first product launches, with direct small-molecule experience; recent small-molecule experience preferred.
* Deep knowledge and practical application of FDA, EMA, ICH, GMP, GCP, and GVP requirements, including ICH Q9(R1) and ICH Q10 principles.
* Demonstrated experience personally designing, implementing, or materially transforming pharmaceutical QMS and QRM frameworks in organizations without mature commercial Quality systems.
* Experience leading FDA and international regulatory inspections and interacting with global health authorities.
* Experience overseeing Quality in an outsourced development and manufacturing model, including CMOs, CDMOs, CROs, and other GxP vendors.
* Proven ability to build and scale Quality organizations, lead through influence, and provide clear, risk-based recommendations to executive leadership and Boards.
* Occasional domestic travel required; international travel may be required

**Benefits & Perks**
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees and their families, including:
 
 

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage: Leona covers 100% of employee premiums and 80% of dependent premiums (Premera Blue Cross PPO, Delta Dental, VSP)
* 401(k) with employer match: immediate eligibility, with Leona matching 100% of employee contributions up to 4% of salary
* Generous PTO: 25 days accrued annually, plus 11 paid holidays and a company-wide closure the last week of December
* Life & disability coverage: Basic Life, AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability fully paid by Leona, with voluntary options available
* Flexible Spending Accounts: Health and Dependent Care FSA options
* Professional development: up to $6,000 annually reimbursed for job-relevant, manager-approved education

**Compensation**
The base salary range for this position is $320,000-$350,000. This role may be eligible for an annual bonus and equity, in addition to our full benefits package outlined above. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skill set, education, and internal pay equity.
 
 
LeonaBio is an equal opportunity employer and does not unlawfully discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on the basis of an individual's race, color, religion, creed, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all terms, conditions and privileges of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, compensation, promotion, discipline and termination.

card.description:
Signia Aerospace is a global, integrated provider of high-performance systems and specialized components for the aerospace industry. Signia designs, manufactures, and services a wide range of products, that include mission equipment, thermal management systems, engine technology, and propellers. The Signia brands are leaders in their respective markets and provide a compelling value proposition to both aerospace and defense OEMs and end-users.
 
 
**Position Overview**
Onboard Systems Hoist & Winch, located in Anaheim, CA is one of the world’s leading providers of Search & Rescue (SAR) and Human External Cargo (HEC) advanced mission equipment for civil, commercial, and military helicopters.
 
 
The Director of Quality is a key leadership position reporting directly to the General Manager (GM), responsible for establishing and executing the company's overall quality strategy. This role provides strategic direction and oversight of the Quality function, ensuring the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS), compliance with AS9100 and applicable regulatory and customer requirements, and continuous improvement across all business operations. As the designated FAA Part 145 Accountable Manager, the Director has authority over all Part 145 repair-station operations, ensures personnel follow applicable FAA regulations, and serves as the primary contact with the FAA. The Director also partners with executive and operational leadership to drive quality performance, manage organizational risk, and foster a company-wide culture of quality and accountability.
 
 
**Location:**
Anaheim, CA (on-site)
 
 
**Schedule:**
Monday - Friday
 
 
**Pay:**
$180,000 - $225,000, plus bonus eligibility
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Quality Management System Leadership
* Establish quality strategy, policies, and measurable objectives aligned with the company's business goals.
* Own and administer the company-wide Quality Management System in accordance with AS9100 (which incorporates ISO 9001) and applicable customer and regulatory requirements, including FAA and, where applicable, EASA requirements.
* Oversee the FAA Part 145 repair-station quality control system, including the Repair Station Manual, Quality Control Manual, Operations Specifications, and documented inspection and return-to-service controls.
* Ensure the QMS is effective, scalable, consistently deployed across the business, and aligned with the company's growth and product roadmap
* Lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives to optimize quality processes, procedures, documentation, and controls.
* Manage document control and maintain accurate, controlled quality procedures, process documentation, and compliance records.
* Compliance & Customer Support
* Serve as the primary point of contact for external audits, including AS9100 certification audits, customer audits, and regulatory assessments.
* Prepare the organization for audits and lead audit responses, corrective actions, and follow-up activities to verify effective closure.
* Build and maintain credibility and trust with executive stakeholders, aerospace OEM customers, auditors, regulatory officials, and relevant industry partners.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable standards, customer requirements, and contractual quality clauses.
* Oversee incoming, in-process, and final manufacturing inspections, including first article inspection (FAI) activities to AS9102 when required by contract or approved procedures, while maintaining distinct FAA Part 145 maintenance-inspection and return-to-service controls.
* Quality Assurance
* Ensure timely containment and investigation of quality issues using methods such as A3, 8D, and 5 Whys, with documented root cause and corrective action (RCCA).
* Support Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams with timely quality guidance and issue resolution.
* Establish quality KPIs and targets, monitor trends, and report performance and improvement plans to the GM and leadership team.
* Use data-driven insights to improve customer satisfaction, compliance, and product consistency; reduce defects and cost of poor quality (COPQ); and verify corrective-action effectiveness.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate product safety, airworthiness, quality, and compliance risks; escalate significant issues to leadership and track mitigation actions to closure.
* Establish clear escalation pathways for nonconforming product and airworthiness concerns; prevent unauthorized product release and ensure release decisions remain with appropriately authorized personnel.
* Lead internal audits and management reviews to ensure ongoing system effectiveness.
* Provide technical leadership and ensure team competency in precision metrology and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
* Lead a risk-based supplier quality program covering supplier qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and supplier corrective-action follow-up.
* Cross-functional Collaboration and Team Leadership
* Partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Program teams to embed quality into design, production, and supplier processes.
* Support new product introduction (NPI) with quality planning, risk assessments, and validation activities.
* Lead and develop the Quality team through clear objectives, coaching, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning.
* Promote a proactive quality culture across the organization through training, mentorship, and leadership by example.

**Who You Are**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of aerospace quality experience, including senior leadership responsibilities and significant responsibility for AS9100-based quality systems.
* Deep working knowledge of aerospace quality principles and requirements.
* Experience working with major aerospace OEMs and their quality expectations.
* Demonstrated experience leading internal, customer, and third-party certification or regulatory audits.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, discipline, and compliance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and communicate effectively with customers, auditors, and executive leadership.
* Proven ability to lead and develop a small, high-impact Quality team.
* Demonstrated ability to lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Working knowledge of 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, including the distinction between production airworthiness approvals and maintenance return to service, and applicable FAA Form 8130-3 issuance and signatory-authorization requirements.
* Experience with FAA-certificated Part 145 repair-station requirements, including regulatory interface and oversight of inspection and return-to-service controls.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of metallurgy and material certification review.
* AS9100 lead auditor training or equivalent demonstrated experience leading aerospace QMS audits.

The Director of Quality is responsible for leading the organization's Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI), risk management, patient safety, accreditation, regulatory compliance, and performance improvement programs. This position provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure the delivery of safe, high-quality, patient-centered care while maintaining compliance with federal, state, and accreditation standards.

The Director collaborates with medical staff, nursing leadership, department directors, and executive leadership to develop a culture of continuous improvement, regulatory readiness, patient safety, and organizational excellence. This role serves as a key resource for performance improvement initiatives, risk reduction strategies, accreditation activities, and quality outcomes reporting.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Quality and Performance Improvement**

* Lead and oversee the hospital's Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) Program.
* Collect, analyze, interpret, and report quality, patient safety, and performance improvement data.
* Develop, implement, and monitor quality indicators, dashboards, scorecards, and performance metrics.
* Facilitate performance improvement projects utilizing evidence-based methodologies and best practices.
* Coordinate organization-wide quality improvement initiatives to improve clinical outcomes, patient experience, and operational effectiveness.
* Prepare and present quality reports to leadership, medical staff committees, quality committees, and the Governing Board.
* Conduct audits, chart reviews, tracers, and compliance assessments to identify opportunities for improvement.

**Risk Management and Patient Safety**

* Direct the organization's risk management and patient safety programs.
* Investigate adverse events, patient complaints, grievances, safety events, near misses, and claims.
* Perform root cause analyses (RCA), failure mode and effects analyses (FMEA), and corrective action planning.
* Identify organizational risks and implement strategies to reduce patient, staff, and visitor harm.
* Monitor trends and implement proactive risk reduction initiatives.
* Collaborate with leadership to develop and monitor corrective action plans and ensure sustained improvements.

**Regulatory Compliance and Accreditation**

* Ensure compliance with CMS Conditions of Participation, Critical Access Hospital regulations, Texas Department of State Health Services requirements, and other applicable federal and state regulations.
* Coordinate survey readiness activities and accreditation preparation.
* Develop, review, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and compliance programs.
* Coordinate responses to regulatory agencies and external surveyors.
* Monitor regulatory changes and communicate requirements throughout the organization.

**Utilization Review and Resource Management**

* Coordinate activities associated with utilization review and clinical resource management.
* Monitor appropriate utilization of healthcare resources and patient care services.
* Evaluate admission, continued stay, and discharge practices for regulatory and quality compliance.
* Analyze utilization data and recommend improvements in resource management and care coordination.
* Collaborate with managed care organizations, payers, and review organizations as appropriate.

**Leadership and Staff Development**

* Supervise and mentor quality analytics personnel.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Provide education and consultation to leaders, providers, and staff regarding quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance.
* Promote interdisciplinary collaboration to improve organizational performance and patient outcomes.

**Data Analysis and Reporting**

* Compile, analyze, and interpret statistical and clinical performance data.
* Prepare executive summaries, reports, presentations, and regulatory submissions.
* Monitor and report outcomes related to patient safety, quality indicators, infection prevention, risk management, and compliance initiatives.
* Utilize data to drive decision-making and performance improvement efforts.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Participate in strategic planning and organizational initiatives.
* Support medical staff quality activities and credentialing-related quality reviews.
* Serve on organizational committees as assigned.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Current, unrestricted Texas Registered Nurse (RN) license.
* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Quality Management, or a related healthcare field.
* Current CPR certification.
* Minimum of three (3) years of progressively responsible experience in healthcare quality, performance improvement, risk management, regulatory compliance, or related healthcare leadership functions.
* Knowledge of CMS Conditions of Participation, Critical Access Hospital regulations, quality measurement methodologies, and healthcare performance improvement principles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, leadership, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with physicians, leadership, regulatory agencies, and interdisciplinary teams.

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or related field.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ).
* Certified Professional in Patient Safety (CPPS) or related certification.
* Experience with QIPP, RAPPS, NHSN, CMS quality reporting programs, and accreditation surveys.
* Experience leading successful regulatory, accreditation, or state survey activities.
* Experience with medical staff bylaws, peer review, credentialing quality processes, and performance improvement programs.

card.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Director of Quality and Risk Management is responsible for providing strategic leadership, oversight, and direction for both the Quality Management and Risk Management programs within the organization. This role develops, implements, and monitors a hospital-wide, data-driven quality improvement program designed to enhance patient outcomes, reduce medical errors, and minimize risks to patients, staff, visitors, and property. The Director ensures compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., The Joint Commission (TJC), Title 22, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), and other applicable standards) and fosters a culture of continuous quality improvement and patient safety throughout the organization.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Quality Management & Performance Improvement***

* Develop and Implement Quality Programs:

* Design, implement, and monitor a comprehensive, hospital-wide quality management and performance improvement program.
* Direct the collection, measurement, and analysis of quality data to identify trends and drive process improvements.
* Education and Training:

* Provide in-service education and training to clinical and administrative staff on quality improvement methodologies, regulatory standards, and data management.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and resource on quality improvement initiatives and continuous quality improvement (CQI) processes.
* Compliance and Reporting:

* Monitor compliance with TJC, Title 22, CMS, and other regulatory standards.
* Oversee the accuracy and timeliness of quality data submissions and reports for internal and external stakeholders.

***Risk Management***

* Manage Risk Programs:

* Oversee the organization’s Risk Management Program by developing and implementing strategies to identify, assess, and mitigate risks to patients, staff, visitors, and property.
* Coordinate the investigation and reporting of incidents, patient/visitor complaints, and potential liability events.
* Incident and Claims Management:

* Maintain and oversee the hospital-wide occurrence reporting system.
* Direct the investigation and documentation of incidents and claims, ensuring that trends are identified and appropriate corrective actions are taken.
* Serve as the primary liaison with internal departments, legal counsel, and external agencies regarding risk management issues and claim defense.
* Evidence Preservation and Litigation Support:

* Safeguard materials obtained during root cause analyses and ensure proper documentation and preservation of evidence.
* Negotiate settlements for minor claims within administrative authority and coordinate litigation support activities when necessary.

***Leadership & Strategic Integration***

* Cross-Functional Collaboration:

* Work closely with senior leadership, clinical staff, and departmental managers to integrate quality and risk management initiatives across the organization.
* Chair or participate in committees (e.g., Patient Safety/Risk Committee) to promote a unified approach to quality and risk management.
* Staff Development:

* Mentor and coach quality and risk management staff to foster professional growth and enhance departmental performance.
* Lead the development of rapid-cycle improvement teams and task forces to address quality and risk-related issues.
* Continuous Improvement:

* Actively participate in continuous quality improvement (CQI) initiatives and contribute to the overall strategic direction of the organization
* Support human resources and performance improvement efforts through active participation in team conferences, staff meetings, and orientation programs.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* General:
* The role primarily involves office work with extended periods of sitting, as well as occasional standing and walking.
* Manual Tasks:

* Frequent use of hands for typing, data entry, and document handling.
* Occasional lifting of light items up to 10–25 pounds may be required.
* Vision:
* No special vision requirements beyond standard capabilities.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* The position is based in a typical office/hospital environment with standard ambient noise levels.
* Occasional exposure to areas with moderate activity levels.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to permit qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or a healthcare-related field is required.
* Master’s Degree is preferred.

**Experience:**

* A minimum of five (5) years of quality and/or risk management experience in an acute care hospital setting is required.
* At least two (2) years of supervisory or administrative management experience is preferred.
* Experience in risk investigation, claims management, and regulatory compliance is highly desirable.

**Licenses/Certificates:**

* Certified Professional Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) is required or must be obtained within one year of hire.
* Other risk management or quality certifications are a plus.

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Demonstrated leadership and management skills with the ability to motivate teams, delegate responsibilities, and drive organizational change.
* In-depth knowledge of regulatory requirements including TJC, Title 22, CMS, and applicable local and federal regulations.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in data collection, performance measurement, statistical analysis, and quality management information systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and familiarity with healthcare information systems and databases.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to negotiate and resolve complex issues.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**It’s not just a job. It’s a mission.**

Altruix is a high-touch pharmacy dedicated to serving behavioral health and intellectual and developmental disability populations. Through our pharmacy expertise, and specialized packaging, we promote medication adherence and improve patient outcomes. Our services help clients take medications as prescribed while reducing administrative burden for providers. Altruix customers achieve measurable results, including 90% adherence rates and a 40% reduction in ER and hospital-related costs. Learn more at www.altruix.com.

Altruix is seeking an experienced **Director of Operations** for the strategic and operational leadership of multiple pharmacy locations within an assigned region. This position provides oversight of pharmacy operations, regulatory compliance, financial performance, workforce management, customer satisfaction, and business growth initiatives.

The Director of Operations partners closely with Pharmacists-in-Charge (PICs), corporate leadership, clients, and regulatory agencies to ensure safe, compliant, efficient, and profitable pharmacy operations while supporting exceptional patient and customer service.

This role requires extensive field presence and direct operational oversight of assigned pharmacy locations. The Director of Operations is expected to spend approximately 80% of working time onsite at pharmacy locations, client facilities, or traveling between sites. Candidates should reside on the East Coast and be able to travel frequently as business needs require.

**Compensation:** $175,000 to $195,000 per year.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Operational Leadership***

* Provide leadership, direction, and oversight for operations across multiple pharmacy locations
* Develop, implement, and monitor operational strategies that drive efficiency, quality, productivity, and service excellence
* Ensure consistent execution of company policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and best practices across all assigned sites
* Identify operational opportunities and implement process improvement initiatives to enhance workflow efficiency and patient outcomes
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics to ensure achievement of business objectives.

 

***Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management***

* Ensure pharmacy operations remain compliant with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations, including Board of Pharmacy requirements, DEA regulations, HIPAA requirements, and other applicable healthcare regulations
* Partner with pharmacy leadership to prepare for and manage regulatory inspections, audits, and accreditation activities
* Maintain accountability for controlled substance security, diversion prevention, inventory controls, and loss prevention programs
* Investigate operational compliance concerns and implement corrective action plans as necessary

 

***Financial Management***

* Maintain accountability for the financial performance of assigned pharmacy locations
* Monitor and manage labor expenses, staffing utilization, productivity, inventory management, purchasing activities, collections, and other financial metrics
* Develop and execute operational plans to achieve budgeted revenue, expense, profitability, and growth targets
* Analyze operational and financial data to identify trends and recommend strategic improvements

 

***Leadership & Talent Development***

* Develop, mentor, and retain high-performing pharmacy leaders, including Pharmacists in-Charge and site management teams
* Provide ongoing coaching, performance feedback, and professional development opportunities for employees
* Foster a culture of accountability, engagement, continuous improvement, and 
 operational excellence
* Conduct performance evaluations and support corrective action, employee relations, and succession planning activities as appropriate
* Ensure all employees complete required training and maintain necessary licensure and certifications

 

***Customer & Client Relations***

* Establish and maintain strong relationships with clients, prescribers, facility leadership, and key business partners
* Serve as a primary operational liaison between pharmacy locations and customers
* Promote a patient-centered culture focused on service excellence and responsiveness
* Address operational concerns and customer service issues in a timely and effective manner

 

***Business Growth & Site Development***

* Support organizational growth initiatives through implementation of new pharmacy locations, service lines, and client partnerships
* Lead operational planning associated with pharmacy startups, licensing activities, facility build-outs, staffing, training, and go-live readiness
* Identify opportunities to increase prescription volume, expand services, improve market penetration, and strengthen client relationships
* Collaborate with executive leadership on strategic planning and organizational growth initiatives

 

***Expectations***

* Achieve established operational, financial, compliance, quality, and customer service goals across all assigned pharmacy locations
* Maintain full compliance with applicable federal, state, Board of Pharmacy, DEA, HIPAA, and company requirements
* Ensure pharmacy locations operate efficiently, consistently, and in accordance with established policies, procedures, and quality standards
* Develop, mentor, and retain effective Pharmacy Managers, Pharmacists-in-Charge (PICs), and site leadership teams
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, patient outcomes, customer satisfaction, and financial performance
* Partner effectively with clients, prescribers, facility leadership, and internal stakeholders to support operational excellence and business growth
* Maintain a visible leadership presence throughout the assigned region through regular onsite visits, operational reviews, employee coaching, and stakeholder engagement
* Travel extensively, including overnight travel as needed, and spending approximately 80% of working time onsite at pharmacy locations, customer sites, or in transit between locations to provide operational oversight and leadership support
* Demonstrate sound judgment, professionalism, and discretion when handling 
 confidential, sensitive, or business-critical information

 

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, pharmacy, or related field
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive leadership experience in pharmacy operations, healthcare operations, or multi-site management
* Experience managing operational performance, compliance, staffing, and budgets across multiple locations
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel extensively
* PharmD degree, MBA, MHA, or other advanced business or healthcare-related degree
* Seven (7) or more years of pharmacy operations leadership experience. 
 Long-term care, institutional, specialty pharmacy, or closed-door pharmacy experience
* Experience launching new pharmacy locations and managing regulatory licensing activities

 

**BENEFITS:**

* Salary: $175,000 to $195,000 based on experience annually. Compensation will be commensurate with equity and experience for roles of similar scope and responsibility
* Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability
* 401(k) program
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays

 

**EEOC:**

Altruix is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, placement, training, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation, or other employment practices based on any protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. Altruix is a drug-free workplace and requires pre-employment drug and alcohol testing as a condition of employment.

card.description:
**Join Our Team as the Director of Operations at ARRO Water Services!**

This position is responsible for providing strategic leadership and oversight of water and wastewater operations across multiple facilities and service areas. The Director of Operations ensures the safe, reliable, and efficient delivery of services while maintaining regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and client satisfaction.

The Director of Operations works closely with executive leadership, operations management, regulatory agencies, and clients to support organizational growth, financial performance, and long-term operational planning.

This role is instrumental in developing high-performing teams and fostering a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of water and wastewater operations across multiple facilities and service areas.
* Oversee treatment facilities, pumping stations, distribution systems, and collection systems.
* Ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal environmental, safety, and public health regulations.
* Lead, mentor, and develop operations management teams while supporting workforce planning and succession development.
* Develop and implement operational strategies, policies, procedures, and performance standards.
* Oversee operating and capital budgets, financial performance, and resource allocation.
* Monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reliability, and service delivery.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with clients, regulatory agencies, and key stakeholders.
* Provide leadership during emergencies, system failures, and regulatory incidents.
* Collaborate with internal teams to support infrastructure improvements, asset management, and long-term planning.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with organizational safety policies and OSHA requirements.
* Support business development, client retention, and organizational growth initiatives.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Public Administration, or a related field strongly preferred.
* Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and relevant industry experience may be considered.
* 10–15 years of progressive water and/or wastewater operations experience, including significant leadership experience.
* Pennsylvania Water and/or Wastewater Operator Certification of the appropriate class and subclass required; advanced certifications preferred.
* Valid Pennsylvania driver’s license required.
* Extensive knowledge of water and wastewater treatment processes, PA DEP regulations, and environmental compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience managing teams, budgets, and complex operational activities.
* Strong leadership, communication, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of SCADA systems, asset management, and operational technologies.
* Ability to travel regularly between facilities and respond to operational emergencies as needed.

**Benefits**

ARRO Water Services offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, paid time off, paid holidays, life and disability insurance, and opportunities for professional development, training, and career advancement.

**Daily Work Location/Hours**

This is a full-time, salaried exempt position responsible for overseeing water and wastewater operations across multiple facilities and service areas. Work is performed in both office and field environments, with regular travel to operational facilities, client locations, and meetings.

Standard working hours are during normal business hours; however, flexibility may be required to accommodate operational needs, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and after-hours emergency situations.

We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

**Summary/Objective**

The Vice President of Technical Operations & Support is a senior technology leader accountable for the secure, reliable, and seamless support of API's mission-critical software applications and employee systems. This leader sets the strategy for, and runs, all technical operations (application support, incident management, observability, and company and employee systems support) and technical support functions (Customer Support and Tier 2/Tier 3 support teams). With teams based in Canada and India and contract resources worldwide, the Vice President will lead a multi-tier support and operations organization, fostering a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and technical growth. The core objective is optimal system performance and superior customer and employee satisfaction and retention, driven by data and continuous improvement.

**Essential Functions:** *Reasonable* ***accommodations*** *may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* Define team structure, roles, and career paths; set goals, KPIs, and performance expectations; and partner with HR and talent acquisition to recruit, coach, and retain skilled professionals
* Partner with infrastructure and application engineering, product, security, and business leaders to ensure product stability and that employee systems meet and exceed business and client needs

* Oversee Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 workflows with clear escalation paths and knowledge transfer to engineering; maintain a searchable knowledge base and self-service resources to reduce repeat tickets
* Own the incident management process end-to-end, including severity definitions, major incident command (with the Senior Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Technical Operations as infrastructure technical lead), and communication to customers and executives
* Monitor ticket aging, MTTR, and CSAT; use the data to identify systemic issues and prioritize improvements
* Serve as the executive escalation point for strategic customers and key accounts, joining business reviews and leading communication during major outages

* Deploy proactive detection, including synthetic monitoring, anomaly detection, and AI-based correlation, to find issues before customers report them
* Partner with the Senior Director on infrastructure and network telemetry, and with application engineering on instrumentation; report coverage, MTTD, MTTR, and alert quality to executives

* Oversee the availability, governance, and performance of Microsoft 365, Entra, Teams, and related platforms; partner with security on identity, access, and endpoint standards
* Champion AI-enabled automation across support and operations, such as ticket triage, knowledge retrieval, and self-healing, in partnership with security and AI tooling owners

* Drive continuous improvement through rigorous RCA, with partner teams committing to and tracking corrective actions in a shared backlog
* Build shared dashboards and metrics with partner teams, and extend these processes to external vendors and partners through agreed escalation paths and SLAs

* Develop and execute a multi-year technology operations and support strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals, product strategy, and growth
* Report regularly to the SVP of Infrastructure Engineering and Technical Operations and executive leadership on service performance, satisfaction, reliability, cost, and initiative progress
* Manage the operations and support budget, including headcount, tooling, and vendor spend, with accurate forecasting and variance analysis
* Lead vendor relationships for support, service management, observability, and employee enablement tools, including negotiations and SLA management

Competencies

* Exceptional leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with experience building, scaling, and retaining high-performing technical teams across geographies and time zones
* Strong service-delivery orientation and commitment to customer experience
* Executive presence; able to convey complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders and translate operational metrics and investment needs into clear narratives for C-suite audiences
* Customer-facing credibility; builds trust with strategic customers and communicates clearly and calmly during outages and escalations
* Strategic thinking balanced with operational discipline, with strong project management skills
* Data-driven; uses SLOs, KPIs, and service metrics to identify trends, prioritize investments, and report on effectiveness
* Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, system design, and software development lifecycle principles, sufficient to partner credibly with engineering during major incidents
* Commitment to a blameless culture and continuous learning; experience with AI-based automation for support efficiency and self-healing
